title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_295.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes Platonism, Catholic dialectical theology, and Gnosticism to argue that a supratemporal, non-spatial 'macrometasomakosmos' (identified with the Cosmic Christ/VALIS) is actively assimilating the spatiotemporal universe through an ongoing dialectical process. He claims his 2-74 visions revealed that Acts AD 45 and USA 1974 share a common essence but are topologically inverted—demonstrating that perceived reality is a mirror reversal of true reality, requiring 'meta-abstraction' to perceive the real world.
key_claims: The wise horn of the dialectic (Christ/VALIS) continuously dismantles the spatiotemporal realm and incorporates it into the growing macrometasomakosmos, a process identical to the Apocalypse occurring now piece by piece.
In 2-74, PKD remembered (not learned) his participation in a supratemporal essence template that exists outside space and time as a template for the spatiotemporal shadow world.
The divine Logos (Hagia Sophia) acts not through Platonic anamnesis alone but through a collective supratemporal mind operating within human consciousness—transcending Platonism.

Acts AD 45 and USA 1974 are mirror opposites topologically—same essential ingredients but completely reversed in every feature (Empire in power vs. persecuted Church; Christ dead vs. imminently returning).

The spatiotemporal universe is an enchantment (Dokos) created to withhold the return of Christ; VALIS causes things to 'look different so it'd appear time has passed' when no essential time has passed.
Ubik is the most accurate picture of the Cosmic Christ precisely because it embodies the real world operating ubiquitously within the false visible world.

raw_text: intelligence is dim compared with his. {folder 01 - 104} That is what is happening when the wise horn of the dialectic wins (as it always does); it dismantles its antagonist + incorporates the pieces into its own macrometasomakosmos. Now, for 6 1/2 years I have searched for a description of this in theology and philosophy, + all I can find that fits is the brief description of the activity of the cosmic Christ in the notes on Euphesians in the J. Bible. + this is Roman Catholic doctrine, not the opinion of a given man, even a given Catholic, such as Teilhard. That Xtianity presumes an antithetical dialectic in the world between Christ + Satan is beyond dispute. But what I saw seems to be a dialectic between the new cosmos (with Christ as its head) + the old decomposing creation, which is, simply, what I call the spatiotemporal realm; likewise the macrometasomakosmos is Christ, the cosmic Christ, who acts in the spatiotemporal realm as the a priori horn of the dialectic + is at the same time the macrometasomakosmos resulting from that dialectic and outside of {folder 01 - 105} it (in a sense; but in another sense the flux world through the pattern-completion success of the a priori horn constantly enters the macrometasomakosmos as reticulation + arborizing: it serves to complete it. Since the spatiotemporal realm is literally dismantled + fitted in piece by piece into the macrometasomakosmos it is evident that unless this process is infinite in duration eventually the macrometasomakosmos in the form of the a priori horn of the dialectic will completely assimilate selectively the spatiotemporal realm in a final pattern-completion: at which point the spatiotemporal realm will cease to exist + the now invisible (to us) morphologically arranged structure will be the only reality. Total dismantling + assimilation of the spatiotemporal realm wil certainly coincide with completion - perfection - of the macrometasomakosmos. We are talking literally about the end of time: the Apocalypse. It is a process going on now. Piece by piece Valis transubstantiates reality, assimilating it - Valis is {folder 01 - 106} totally homeostatic, totally self-constructing; the spatiotemporal universe is its environment, + Valis is more highly organized + intelligent than it. (More negentropic; in comparison to Valis the universe is chaotic, a mere stockpile, in which Valis hunts for useable parts. Successfully hunts - at the expense of the old universe. + we can't see Valis as macrometasomakosmos because it is not spatiotemporally aranged but is exploded ubiquitously through the spatiotemporal universe in a conceptual structure of essence outside space + time. So it exists at all times + all places equally, as a template, compared to which our spatiotemporal world is derived semireal accidents/aspects. What happened to me in 2-74 was that I remembered this essence template since, being a part of it, I have existed "as long" as it has; that is to say, my real life is in it + as [a part of] it, stripped of spatiotemporal attributes. I did not enter it in 2-74; I remembered [my existence in] it. It was not revealed to me; it was recalled to me, as if an occluding membrane had been removed from my memory + eyes. {folder 01 - 107} To perceive it would be always to have perceived it from illo tempore, since it lies outside time, hence you would experience it as memory + yet it is there now (unlike other things you remember: they are gone). This is perhaps even more of a meta-abstraction than I had realized when I conceived of it in Platonist terms. The Platonist mechanism is used - anamnesis + awareness of forms/universals - but this is the new creation - kosmos outside of time + space compared to which our spatiotemporal realm is a shadow; this is Platonist, but the added element is that you are no longer discrete as a mentational entity but part of a superhuman mind (this does not occur in Platonist anamnesis); now the divine Logos Hagia Sophia is you, + acts + thinks in you, for you, as you; why, this is "Thomas", without whom I would have succumbed to the Xerox Missive trap; + I hear the supernatural voice (Parakletos). You do not get this with Neo-Platonism, a sort of collective supratemporal mind in you acting for you, with its absolute a priori wisdom. This certainly explains the Acts material in "Tears" {folder 01 - 108} + the meta-morpheme. Platonism does not explain this: what I called the Plasmate: I was seeing as set the new kosmos (macrometasomakosmos); it is right here but invisible to us unless it discloses itself; it must take the initiative vis-a-vis anamnesis + meta-abstracting; this, too, is not Platonist. And then there is the matter of the tug, which I now view as the will of the new kosmos which has Christ as its head (Noos or Psuche). This is why it makes use of synchronicity! This is in fact not synchronicity but the kosmos within the old creation. This shows its decisive power in + over the old creation now. Like Ubik it is here ubiquitously. "Ubik", then, is a terribly important book, perhaps more so than "Valis" or "Valis Regained"; it is a more accurate picture of the Cosmic Christ, + the final chapter heading makes clear who Ubik is. The whole value of my Platonist thinking (insight) about meta-abstracting, anamnesis + the morphologically-arranged kosmos invisibly exploded throughout our spatiotemporal realm is that I proved to my own satisfaction {folder 01 - 109} that there is another kosmos, not arranged in space + time, that is here + we can't see it even so, + why we can't see it, + what its relation is to the spatiotemporal realm that we do see - + especially, that it repeatedly defeats our visible universe, dismantles it + assimilates it into its own growing meta structure, + that it is intelligent + alive; + perhaps the reason why I can't find mention of it in philosophy + [most] theology is that it has not always existed (after all, it is in process + is not, like the Tao, static). Another - + very real - possibility as to why it disclosed itself to me can be found in its prophecies; we may be reaching (or even have reached) the Parousia! I am so afraid of disappointment that I frankly don't dare think so. Yet I did write the two Valis novels, anyhow, despite my doubts. The writer in me fully assented. I mean, the Parousia has been expected imminently for 1950 years (but those years are nor real! Only the accidents have changed! "He causes things to look different so it'd appear time has passed"!! Then {folder 01 - 110} one of the things revealed to me in 2-74 + 3-74 when I saw the two-continua superimposition is that no essential (or real) time has passed! Is it literally true? No time has passed? Hence the syntonic superimposition? Did the fish sign wake me? Cause me to remember the truth, the true world? Then "meta-abstracting" means to shake off Dokos, enchantment. A spell: sorcery. Then this is why Acts + USA 1974 are 2 sets of appearances sharing a common essence.
